messages:
sam: Kicking off a quiet-window canary for v2026.06 with feature `early-batch=true`. Canary 10% across regions. Please watch SLO dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/slo/serve and call out any 4xx/5xx or p95 regressions.

deploy-bot: Deploy accepted by sam. Version=v2026.06 Canary=10% Feature=early-batch=true. Notifying @eng-oncall. CI: green.

mona: quick scan: ap-southeast shows 429s rising to 0.6% over the last 45s, p95 for embeds up from 210ms -> 380ms. Other regions look fine.

observability-bot: Alert: region=ap-southeast embeds route 429 > 0.5% (1m). Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.local/runbooks/deploy-triage.

ops-sre: hold ramp and consider regional mitigation. Options: 1) region route-pin to previous version, 2) flip feature flag off in ap-southeast, 3) increase upstream rate limits (slower). Fastest: regional feature flip or pin.

sam: pausing ramp. @deploy-bot hold-ramp. We'll triage. Adding note to release draft: "ap-southeast 429s during canary".

deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged. Canary frozen at 10%.

tara: digging traces -> new batching header triggers upstream per-client rate calc; ap-southeast upstream env has stricter limits. Recommending per-region feature disable while we coordinate with the upstream team.

mona: agree. Please execute `feature-toggle --region ap-southeast early-batch off` and pin if toggle doesn't stabilize within 2m.

ops-sre: executing toggle now. I'll watch 429 and p95. If 429 persists >0.5% for 3m we route-pin to v2026.05.

ops-sre: feature toggle applied. Monitoring.

mona: 429s dropping to 0.12% within 30s. p95 returning to ~220ms. Nice.

sam: thanks. keeping ramp held for 10m observation, then we'll resume ramp without early-batch in ap-southeast. Update release notes: "early-batch disabled for ap-southeast due to upstream rate limits; global rollout continues."

deploy-bot: Note: canary remains at 10%. Will resume when you command. Auto-alert thresholds tightened for 4xx/5xx in ap-southeast for the next 60m.

observability-bot: Ticket created: ENG-INT-310 - coordinate with upstream team on batching rate limits, assigned to tara and mona.

sam: proceeding with monitored hold. If anything regresses we'll either apply a regional pin or rollback. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
